title: Rotate PDF
h1: Rotate PDF Pages Online — Free & Private
seoTitle: Rotate PDF Online Free — Turn Pages Sideways or Upside Down
description: Rotate PDF pages by 90°, 180° or 270° — all pages, odd, even or a custom range. Free, runs in your browser, and your file is never uploaded.
intro: Fix scanned pages that came out sideways or upside down. Rotate the whole document or only the pages you choose, then download the corrected PDF — everything happens on your device.
blurb: Rotate all or selected PDF pages by 90°, 180° or 270° — free and private.

controls.label: Pages
controls.help: Separate pages or ranges with commas. Use 7- for page 7 to the end.

howItWorks: Click the upload area or drag a PDF onto it — the file is read locally and its page count appears straight away.
Choose which pages to turn and how far: 90° clockwise, 180°, or 90° counter-clockwise.
Press Rotate PDF — the corrected file downloads straight away, with all other content left untouched.
examples: Turn a scanned document that came out sideways by rotating all pages 90° clockwise.
Fix only the landscape pages of a report by listing them, such as 4, 9-11.
Flip every other page upside down after double-sided scanning by using the even pages option.

faq.q: Is my PDF uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. The file is processed entirely in your browser with a local PDF library, so it never leaves your device and nothing is stored or logged.

faq.q: Does rotating reduce the quality of my PDF?
faq.a: No. Only the page rotation setting changes, so text, images and layout are kept exactly as they were and the file is not re-rendered or compressed.

faq.q: Can I rotate only some pages?
faq.a: Yes. Pick Odd, Even or Custom in the Which pages menu. For Custom, type page numbers and ranges separated by commas, for example 1-3, 5, 8-10.

faq.q: Can I rotate a password-protected PDF?
faq.a: Encrypted or password-protected PDFs can't be rotated directly. Remove the password in your PDF viewer first, then add the file again.
